data.body:
Systemic stale-path sweep across this epic, against origin/main d74d53a5ffd.

The reconciler package move has LANDED. src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/ and tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/ are both gone; the code is at src/rebar/reconciler and the tests at tests/unit/reconciler/. Six tickets still named the old path — this epic and 19c3, 2a3d, 361f, 8257, b721 — and in every case it sat in a pytest target or an AC grep, where it would have failed collection and made the plan's own verification a broken oracle.

All six are corrected. Two of them (19c3, b721) also carried a hedge sentence saying the paths were 'stated at the current name' because 'the reconciler epic rename carries them' — written while that rename was still pending. It is no longer pending, so the hedge was asserting something false about the tree; both now state the post-rename path directly and record the measurement sha.

Counts re-verified at the new location rather than assumed: the 6 held-out pairs under the reconciler tree are still 2 in diffing/, 3 in state/ and 1 at the package root, exactly as 19c3 claims. tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_backend_scalar_surface{,_heldout}.py both exist, so this epic's autouse-fixture ratchet note still holds.

One further drift found in b721: its 'handled elsewhere' carve-out names 8 tests/scripts/*_seam_clean_heldout.py modules and test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py. None of the 9 exist any more — the seam story E10a-S1 has landed. The carve-out is still correct, but it described pending work; it now records that the work is done.
